text:
Olivia: FYI AcmeTrial just reported a spike of 5xxs during a scripted demo run at 09:07PT. They replayed a dataset; traffic hit ~300 rps for a few minutes. CISO wants RCA + mitigation.

Priya: Thanks. Any request ids or model info?

Olivia: Model: r-instruct-large-v1 (hosted). Sample req IDs: e9f2c4, 4b7a91. Errors look like 502/503.

Mateo: I'm pulling frontdoor logs now. Early read: queue length jumped, workers returned grpc UNAVAILABLE (14) and some model-load delays. Autoscale did attempt to add nodes but new pods stayed NotReady for ~20s.

Quinn: Can we short-circuit with a fallback route to r-instruct-medium-quant for this tenant? That would use smaller kernels and likely avoid long init.

Priya: Fallback + reduce tenant batch size should help immediately. Also enabling a 1-GPU warm instance for the next 6h will eliminate cold-starts.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: scale request accepted for eval-pool-4 (+3 nodes) at 09:08:12

Olivia: Sales: cost question for warm-instance for demo window?

Priya: Rough estimate: prewarm hourly = $0.60/hr (eval GPU). 6h = ~$3.60. Low impact; we can offer first 2h courtesy.

Mateo: I uploaded diagnostic bundle: https://redwood-internal/diag/2635000123 (frontdoor spans, worker logs, model load times, autoscale events). No OOMs. Model load times ~15-22s on new pods (quant kernel JIT).

Quinn: Quick client suggestion: add client-side retry 2x with tiny jitter and set batch_size=1. I'll paste snippet.

Quinn: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
 -d '{"model":"r-instruct-large-v1","max_tokens":128,"batch_size":1}'
```

Quinn: Backoff: base=150ms, jitter, max=1s.

Priya: Operational plan I propose: (1) enable tenant fallback to medium-quant, (2) set tenant max_batch=1, (3) provision 1 warm instance for 6h, (4) temporarily switch eval-pool scale policy to queue-based with cooldown 30s.

deploy-bot: apply: tenant(acmetrial).fallback=r-instruct-medium-quant -> accepted
deploy-bot: apply: tenant(acmetrial).max_batch=1 -> accepted

Mateo: Policy flip in 2m. Will watch queue and errors.

Priya: Sales: I'll send a short note with estimated cost and the mitigation steps. Also attaching the diag link for CISO. If they require retention beyond default 30d, we'll loop in security/legal.

Olivia: Can we commit to a "demo safe" window? They want assurance.

Priya: We can't guarantee zero 5xxs, but with these steps risk is very low. Recommend a short practice run at the demo start time with traffic replay to validate.

Mateo: After changes, 5xx rate dropped from ~10% -> 1.2% within 5m. Queue draining normally.

Quinn: I'll keep this thread updated. If Sales wants the warm pool extended I'll add the pricing detail to the ticket.

Olivia: Thanks all. I'll tell Acme we implemented mitigations and scheduled a practice run for demo hour. :thumbsup:
